title: Chapter 990
text:
On Planet Three Kings, two people were walking side by side in the quiet corridor of the government palace.

One of them was a high-level intelligence officer, and the other was a high-ranking official of the Modo Civilization. His position was Madi's leader.

The two of them chatted casually as they walked.

"You're in charge of the project of making use of the natives and report directly to the Three Kings. This is a rare opportunity." The high-ranking official walked with his hands behind his back. "Madi, I've always believed in your abilities. However, can you guarantee that the dynasty won't find out the truth? If anything happens, the Three Kings will remember you, and your future will end here. "

"Hehe, I've said it many times. The dynasty won't be able to find out that we did it."

Madi shook his head and sneered.

"I've already dealt with all traces a few years ago. The serial number of the spaceship has been completely erased, and I've also used magic many times to interfere with the prophecy ability. The dynasty won't be able to find any information on this spaceship, so what other clues can they have?

"Even if the dynasty really found out where the spaceship came from, I've already gotten the intelligence officers to erase all the production and transaction records of the spaceship. The dynasty won't be able to find anything. Furthermore, that intelligence officer has disguised himself, and there's nothing suspicious about his resume. Outsiders will only think that he's dead. His confidential files have been temporarily deleted from the database, and I've also transferred him away. No one will be able to find him.

"Furthermore, we weren't the ones who bought this spaceship but a private financial group. It's been sold many times, and it was even stolen by galactic pirates. There were no survivors, and it became a missing spaceship. We only secretly seized it more than ten years ago, and there are no records of it left behind. Thus, if the dynasty wants to find out about this transaction, they won't be able to find us.

"A few years is more than enough, and I've also made some arrangements. If the dynasty continues to investigate, they will only be led to suspect that it's another Supercluster civilization. No matter what, the dynasty won't be able to find any evidence that we did it."

Madi's tone was filled with confidence.

After all, sending the spaceship to the Kunde Race was something that happened a few years ago. He had already started to erase all traces a few years ago, and he was very confident that the dynasty would not be able to find any clues.

The high-ranking official nodded slowly.

"I'm relieved to hear that."

…

The silver-blue planet slowly rotated in the universe before his eyes like a gem rolling on black velvet. The starlight reflected on the smooth silver armor of the Lord's Avatar, and the pitch-black mechanical soldiers silently followed behind, as if they had merged into one with the darkness.

This was a comprehensive industrial planet in the Primeval Star River, and a large number of financial groups had set up factories here.

[Bold Explorer] revealed that it was a division of labor under a shipbuilding company. It was located on this planet, and it was the origin of the fallen spaceship.

This shipyard belonged to the most ordinary type of shipyard. It only mass-produced low-grade spaceships of various basic models. It did not carry out any research and development, and all it earned was production fees.

Shipyards like this still had a certain market in the universe, and they mainly accepted orders from the public. After all, basic spaceships were cheap and in high demand, and other advanced shipyards would not invest large amounts of resources to produce such basic spaceships that had no core competitiveness.

Before Han Xiao sent out the mechanical army, he had already checked the background of this shipyard in the database. It was just a small private enterprise with no background.

"The mastermind chose this shipyard. If I'm not wrong, they've already erased all traces."

Han Xiao pondered.

Although he had an idea in his heart, he still had to check it out to verify the results.

Entering the quantum network, his vision turned into a virtual networked world again. The outline of the planet in front of him blurred, and only countless glowing quantum network nodes were left, forming a mottled sea of light.

After locking onto the quantum network node of the shipyard, Han Xiao directly entered. The data firewall of a small private enterprise was like air, and it did not have any effect on him. He went all the way to the deepest part of the network and released a huge amount of data.

In just an instant, Han Xiao had destroyed the database of this shipyard, and all the information was leaked to Han Xiao.

He opened the production log and transaction records and found that the earliest record was only three years ago, and the history of this shipyard was far longer than that.

"As expected, the mastermind did something," Han Xiao thought to himself.

He checked the other records and found that this shipyard had an accident three years ago.

During the production of the spaceship, there was a problem with the energy source, which caused the entire shipyard to explode. The mainframe was destroyed, and all the data was lost. The paper records were also gone, and it almost affected the surrounding enterprises.

After the investigation, it was found that there was a very small chance of a natural failure. Han Xiao did not believe that it was a man-made disaster to destroy evidence.

If he was the mastermind, not only would he have to erase the records of where the spaceship was produced, but he would also have to turn the spaceship into a ghost ship that had no records for a long time.

"There are no records, and I still don't know the serial number of the spaceship. This lead is more than half broken …"

Han Xiao's Lord's Avatar's eyes flashed.

"However, it's not like I didn't find anything."

At the very least, this lead revealed that the spaceship was produced in the Primeval Star River.

Then, the biggest suspects in the Primeval Star River would be the four Supercluster Civilizations. The range of possibilities had been narrowed down from the entire universe to just a Star Field.

Of course, there was also the possibility that the civilizations in the other Star Fields had purposely bought spaceships from other civilizations with the intention of framing them. However, he had to consider the possibility of this happening first.

Although he did not have any leads at the moment, in his previous life, the dynasty had also encountered an incident similar to the Kunde Race. The natives had been strengthened and sent to their deaths. After the incident with the Kunde Race, the dynasty was more prepared and discovered some of the suspects.

Among the suspects in the Primeval Star River, the Modo Civilization, one of the Four Supercluster Civilizations, was named the most!

They often caused trouble, so how could they not get their shoes wet? The dynasty was not to be trifled with either.

The mastermind could erase the clues of the past, but he had no way of changing the clues of the 'future' in Han Xiao's memories!

It was as if he had not committed a crime yet, but he would commit a crime in the future.

He did not know if the Kunde Race incident was caused by the Modo Civilization, but since they had a 'criminal record', they were the biggest suspects.

Because the clues were broken, Han Xiao had two thoughts.

If the accident at the shipyard was caused by someone, he could try to find the records and surveillance of this planet from three years ago and see if he could find out who caused the accident.

It was easy for the mastermind to tamper with the data of a small private enterprise, but it was much more difficult to tamper with the surveillance of the entire planet. If the mastermind had tampered with the surveillance, Han Xiao would just treat it as a dead end.

The second method was the dumbest method, which was to use the elimination method. There were only a few civilizations in the Primeval Star River that could cause trouble, and he would investigate them one by one. If he did that, the first civilization that Han Xiao would investigate would be the Modo Civilization, which was the biggest suspect.

He had always liked to do two things at the same time. He immediately filtered the records from three years ago and matched them with the surveillance of the satellite on the day of the accident.

With his powerful computing ability, he quickly obtained a result. There were no suspicious individuals near the shipyard on that day.

"It's not an outsider? Hmm, there are two possibilities. First, the mastermind tampered with the surveillance of the entire planet to hide the traces of an outsider. Second, it's an employee. "

Han Xiao could not do anything about the former, so he could only think of an employee.

If it was not an outsider, then it could only be an insider.

"If I'm the culprit and received orders from my superior to do this, then there's no need for me to stay in the shipyard after creating a disaster and completing my mission. Therefore, I need an excuse to leave. In that case … "

Han Xiao opened the obituary of the employees that the shipyard had announced three years ago. It listed all the employees that had died in the accident.

After the accident three years ago, all the surviving shipwrights had been strictly interrogated, and many of them had left their jobs. However, according to Han Xiao's understanding of intelligence agents, the possibility of them faking their deaths to disappear from the face of the earth was higher. This was because it was more 'clean'. Excellent intelligence agents would definitely prepare multiple identities for themselves. Death was equivalent to destroying their identities, washing away their ties and greatly reducing their worries.

Therefore, it was very likely that the culprit was on the death list.

The biographies of the galactic residents could be checked through other channels. It was not difficult for Han Xiao to check the biographies of these people. Their professional experience and immigration records were all very clear.

What he needed to confirm now was whether anyone's biographies were fake.

It was easy to tamper with information, but it was not difficult to verify it. It was just more tedious, and that was to visit the companies and relatives shown in the biographies and ask if there was such a person.

If someone was found to have faked their biographies, then they could be listed as a suspect. The next step was to use the elimination method that he had just thought of. He would compare the biographies of the suspects with the biographies of the Modo Civilization and the other Supercluster civilizations to determine if they were the culprit and what organization they belonged to.

If the culprit was hiding in the shipyard, they would have definitely used a fake identity and disguised their appearance. However, this was not impossible.

The data of the shipyard was gone, but the satellite surveillance of the planet was still there. With Han Xiao's Virtual Technology, he could set up a model parameter and import these videos and the biographies of those organizations into it. He could then conduct a large-scale comprehensive analysis to determine the similarity and see through the disguise.

This way, he could complete the comparison with the biographies of the civilizations.

Then, the question was … how could he obtain the biographies of these Supercluster civilizations?

The Black Star Corps did not have much influence in the Primeval Star River.

Han Xiao patted his metal head.

He did not know about the others, but someone like Manison, who had a strong desire for control, definitely had a large amount of the biographies of these Supercluster civilizations.

Even the Radiant Federation had to guard against the Virtual Intrusion of the Mecha Empire, so Han Xiao most likely had a record. How could these Supercluster civilizations be spared? With the number one Virtual Technology in the universe, it would be a waste not to be the next-door neighbor.

"Alright, looks like I really have to look for the Mecha Empire."
